text: “I wonder why he has not come to tell me?” “He went out of Egdon Heath the next day, so would not be likely to know you wanted him.” “Christian,” said Clym, “you must go and find Venn. I am otherwise engaged, or I would go myself. Find him at once, and tell him I want to speak to him.” “I am a good hand at hunting up folk by day,” said Christian, looking dubiously round at the declining light; “but as to night-time, never is such a bad hand as I, Mister Yeobright.” “Search the heath when you will, so that you bring him soon. Bring him tomorrow, if you can.” Christian then departed. The morrow came, but no Venn.
